method: Separate post-draft reading for clarity, repetitive phrasing and traceable evidence; factual comparison with retained check, extraction, warning and site receipts.
score_reason: Concrete numbers, file names and explicit limits dominate; required report sections cause some repetition and compressed technical phrasing.
confidence_reason: Self-assessment of a constrained technical report; no independent naturalness benchmark was performed.

examples.quote: Keep PR #236 unmerged. A separate source PR #237 allows a main deployment and clean post-merge freeze without merging governance evidence. Reject silently reusing c2 platform results for the changed README/vignette bytes. Reject suppressing warnings or weakening tests to obtain a cleaner report.

examples.impact: Prevents the checkpoint from implying release completion.
examples.quote: This checkpoint does NOT cover actual source merge or deployment, the new post-merge archive, final Windows warning messages, new scientific default decisions, broad inferential validity, final release-panel READY votes, CRAN upload, confirmation or acceptance. Those remain explicit gates.

science_gate_reason: No new inferential claim or scientific default; recovery and warning validity are explicitly bounded.
facts_gate_reason: Replay totals, route counts, source extraction and pending approval boundaries agree with the retained receipts; CI is explicitly recorded separately after publication.
references_gate_reason: Internal receipt names and PR237/source identifiers checked against source files and live PR metadata.
calibration_status: No calibration examples consulted in this assessment.
